summary: Report native objective ancestor bindings immediately without retiring sibling episodes

replay.detail: Retained objective evidence and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or retained metadata changes.

rules.detail: Native producer reports use full objective evaluation when a declaration selects a strict ancestor of the producer scope. Burning and met mail rows update ancestor-bound fault episodes immediately while other producers' episodes retain their own evidence.

compatibility.detail: Existing native selectors, including agents bindings over agents/mail-delivery, require no declaration changes. Exact and descendant selectors retain scoped evaluation. No wire or client changes.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Unknown source evidence continues to preserve open episodes. Reverting requires no data migration.
